column1: # Known differences of Editor/ShapeMapTest.cs (shape-slider maps vs the game measurements of Phase 1.7).
# A bone of a set that is over the test's thresholds (position 1e-4, angle 0.05 deg, scale 1e-4) is allowed when an entry
# below matches it and its maximum error stays within the entry's tolerances; the run then reports PASS with
# "N known differences allowed". Anything over a threshold without an entry, or an allowed bone over its tolerance, FAILs.
#   set         a set name (female_body, female_face, male_body, male_face) or a pattern with '*' (*_body, male_*, *)
#   correction  on | off | any: the entry applies when the joint correction runs once after each sample (the default of
#               the body sets), with -nocorrect (and for the face sets, which never run it), or always
#   position    tolerance of the max local position component error; '-' = the test threshold
#   angle       tolerance of the max rotation error in degrees; '-' = the test threshold
#   scale       tolerance of the max local scale component error; '-' = the test threshold
#   reason      why the game value differs and where it is followed up
